confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Assumes roughly 50 EGP per USD; the Egyptian pound has been volatile, which is the main uncertainty for a July 2026 window. Restaurant and cafe anchors are best grounded; hotel rates are least certain. Cocktail and wine use beer-relative bases (about 2x and 1.5x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from a single search summary and was not cross-checked against the live RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparator. Benchmarked against low-cost North African and Middle Eastern tourist cities, with Cairo's restaurant and hotel prices in USD terms set below Western European levels. Egypt is a North African country, grouped under Africa here.
